From Heaven's Door · Price: the target must see your drawing or your stand's face.

Theme Mind and Sense

  • 1: 2 actions: a creature that can see your stand (@Check[will|against:stand|traits:incapacitation]{Will}, incapacitation) turns into a book. Failure: you read one fact; critical failure: three facts and it's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{stunned 1}.
  • 5: You can write a minor command in the book ("can't Strike you", "can't speak") for 1 round.
  • 9: Surge: the command lasts 1 minute.
  • 13: Tear a page: the creature forgets the last 10 minutes.
  • 17: Command can be anything the command spell can do, lasting 1 hour (incapacitation).

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC.
